headline: Researcher & Engineering Educator | Intelligent Wireless Systems
summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering researcher and educator specializing in AI/ML for wireless networks, resilient learning, and 5G/6G network intelligence. Research spans propagation modeling, generative data augmentation, digital twins, optimization, self-healing, domain adaptation, and reinforcement learning. Academic work includes teaching, laboratory instruction, student mentoring, research publications, proposal development, and curriculum activities. Industrial R&D at AT&T Labs, Futurewei, Impac, and AT&T brings operational data and applied validation to this research program.

skills.Machine Learning: Deep learning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, adversarial learning, generative modeling, reinforcement learning, classification, time-series analysis, robustness evaluation, and model validation
skills.Wireless & Networked Systems: LTE/4G, 5G-NR, NTN, mobility, RAN, propagation modeling, outage management, self-healing, network measurements, and service assurance
skills.Research Methods: Experimental design, 3GPP-aligned simulation, statistical analysis, cross-validation, reproducible workflows, distribution-shift evaluation, technical writing, and publication development
skills.Engineering Tools: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, cloud analytics, data pipelines, visualization, Git, and Linux
skills.Teaching & Mentoring: Wireless communications, communication systems, programming, machine learning, laboratory instruction, experimental methods, student projects, and research development
